sentence_stem: There are only a few apples left in the basket, so
correct_completion: we need to buy more fruit.
full_sentence: There are only a few apples left in the basket, so we need to buy more fruit.
acceptable_variants: we should go to the market.
we will get some more later.

options.text: we have a big meal tonight.
options.why_wrong: This suggests there is plenty of food, which contradicts 'only a few apples'.

options.text: there are many apples in the shop.
options.why_wrong: This describes a different place. It is not a result of the few apples left in the basket.

options.text: we need to buy more fruit.

options.why_wrong: This is a description of the basket, not a logical result of having few apples.

grammar_focus: There are with quantifiers 'only a few' and result clauses with 'so'
explanation: 'So' introduces a result of the first clause. Because there are only a few apples, the logical result is that more fruit is needed. Polish speakers may expect a contrast here, but 'so' always signals a consequence.
translation: W koszyku zostało tylko kilka jabłek, więc musimy kupić więcej owoców.
